FAQs

Why Nixom Studio?

Most agencies hand you off to juniors or split design and dev across vendors. We don’t. You get a senior, multidisciplinary team that runs as one, handling everything end to end so you never have to coordinate between people.

Who will we work with?

A small, dedicated senior team with a single point of contact. No outsourcing, no rotations. You’ll always know who’s working on your project, what’s happening, and why.

How do we work together?

Async by default via Slack, Figma, and shared docs, with fast feedback loops. You’re never waiting on replies. Calls are always available with your project manager whenever you need them.

Do you offer full-stack engineering?

Yes. Once design is approved, our senior full-stack team implements everything 1:1. One team, one handoff, zero translation errors between design and dev. We obsess over getting it pixel-perfect.

What if priorities change?

That’s expected. We adapt as things shift and keep momentum going. For larger scope changes we’ll clearly recommend next steps so you’re never caught off guard.

Can you work with our team?

Yes. We regularly collaborate with in-house designers and engineers, slot into existing workflows, and handle clean handoffs.

Who owns the work?

You do. Once invoices are paid, everything is yours. No lock-in, no licensing surprises. We’re happy to sign an NDA and work inside your tools from day one.

Pricing

You can choose between a one-time plan or a retainer plan (fixed monthly price), whatever works best for you.
